channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jeff Teague | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jeff Teague from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Derrick Rose, Jeff Teague, Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Patrick Beverley:

“The first team we play against is the Clippers, and if we win, the Minnesota gets into the playoffs after 16 years. Jimmy Butler has been there, Derrick Rose has been there, all these different players have been there, high-level players, all-star, Jeff Teague, all-star caliber type players, and Minnesota has never been there. Andthen you inject Pat Bev in there and we're playing with a number seven seed.”

Patrick Beverley on Derrick Rose, Jeff Teague, Jimmy Butler, Sep 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Jeff Teague
item.description:
Steve Aschburner:ATL's Mike Budenholzer on PG Jeff Teague:

“We're always best when Jeff is aggressive & when Jeff is in attack mode. He understands that.”

Mike Budenholzer on Jeff Teague, May 24, 2015. Source: Twitter @AschNBA.

item.title: DeMarre Carroll on Josh Smith, Jeff Teague
item.description:
“If they were quiet and just did what they did, they wouldn’t have woke up Jeff Teague, they wouldn’t have woke up myself, they wouldn’t have woke up Paul (Millsap). I think that’s when it got chippy and Josh Smith was doing all this.”

DeMarre Carroll on Josh Smith, Jeff Teague, Mar 4, 2015. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: Al Horford on Jeff Teague, Doron Lamb, Marquis Teague, Festus Ezeli
item.description:
Al Horford:

“We have the 23rd pick and I know the team will draft the best player available. I would like to pick a shooter like Kentucky's Doron Lamb. But it wouldn't bother me if they picked a big who could help me like Festus Ezeli(Vanderbilt). Anyway, I doubt they will pick Jeff Teague's brother, Marquis Teague.”

Al Horford on Jeff Teague, Doron Lamb, Marquis Teague, Festus Ezeli, Jun 21, 2012. Source: Primera Hora.
